# Talkti

> Talkti is a free, open-source web app that acts as a real-time language bridge: one person speaks in their own language and the others read the translation and hear it spoken aloud, instantly and in both directions. It currently supports Spanish, English and Japanese.

How it works: speech is transcribed to text in the browser (STT), only text travels between devices through a real-time relay, it is translated with AI on the receiving device, shown as a chat, and read aloud (TTS). Rooms support up to 4 people and the chat is ephemeral (messages auto-delete after 24 hours).

Key facts:
- Free to use, no account or registration required.
- Open source — anyone can self-host it. Running it requires your own backend: a real-time relay + database (Supabase) and an AI translation API key kept server-side.
- Chrome/Edge first: browser speech recognition is not well supported in Safari/Firefox.
- Privacy: voice is processed on the user's device; only text is exchanged; messages are deleted after 24h.
- Tech stack: React 18, Vite 6, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, Supabase (Realtime + Postgres + Edge Functions), Firebase Hosting.

## Pages

- [Home](https://talktiweb.web.app/): Create or join a room and start a translated conversation.

- [Donations](https://talktiweb.web.app/donaciones): Support the project via Ko-fi.
- [Terms and conditions](https://talktiweb.web.app/terminos): Usage terms, privacy and data retention.
